failure_retention: Retain incomplete output and failed receipts; never retry in the same output directory or convert a required refusal into a skip.
fresh_output_constraint: ${FRESH_RAW} must be an absolute canonical fresh directory strictly beneath ${REPO}/ignored (not ${REPO}/ignored itself); its parent must already exist.
launch: Independently review generated binding, then use its exact outer_argv and finite 55-second parent wait through the existing bounded workflow. This materializer never launches or imports the adapter/calibrator.
preparation_controls: Original one accepted/three refused plus separate outside-ignored refusal, all as preparation-cases.json; actual 4/32 still mandatory.
required_clean_receipt: exit 0, no timeout/abort/peers/cleanup events/error, unchanged inputs, ECHILD; exact receipt request/helper/output hashes
